Reference implementation (Python 3.12+):
```python
def first_index(values, target):
    for index, value in enumerate(values):
        if value == target: return index
    return -1

assert first_index([4, 2, 4], 4) == 0
assert first_index([1, 2], 8) == -1
```
explanation: Return on the first matching index. Time O(n), auxiliary space O(1); this deliberately returns the first occurrence.
